name: Mother Cordyceps
description: A warped Fungril hag covered in black-purple fungal stalks. Her mycelium spreads through the mud beneath the entire clearing.

abilities.name: Relentless
abilities.description: Mother Cordyceps can be spotlighted up to twice per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual.

abilities.name: Creeping Mycelium
abilities.description: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. All enemies within Very Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll (14). On a failure, they become Restrained.

abilities.name: Infesting Strike
abilities.description: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d8+4 magic damage and the target becomes Infected. The next time an Infected target rolls with Fear, they must mark a Stress, then the infection ends.

abilities.name: Hunt Them
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to immediately spotlight one Hagbeast without spending Fear.

abilities.name: Protect the Brood
abilities.description: When the Cocoon takes damage from a PC within Close range, Mother Cordyceps may mark a Stress to move into Melee range of that PC and make a standard attack against them.
